description: TuxBox is a new, native-first compatibility layer for running unpacked, decrypted Xbox Series X|S games on x86-64 Linux and Windows.
approach: HLE compatibility layer, native x64 execution. Linux via stock Valve Proton Experimental (Wine PE loader + vkd3d-proton) plus a local Vulkan layer for Xbox CBV offsets; Windows via native D3D12. Shaders: RDNA2 -> HLSL -> DXC -> DXIL (then vkd3d-proton/dxil-spirv -> SPIR-V on Linux). Minimal Xbox libraries; forwards to Proton/Windows APIs or title-shipped DLLs wherever possible.

description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
approach: PS5 executable porting by relinking (no emulation): relinker converts the PS5 ELF to a native ELF/PE, optionally lowers AMD-only CPU instructions (--to-intel), binds imports by NID to reimplemented prx system libraries; RDNA2 shader recompiler to SPIR-V for Vulkan. Linux and Windows.
contents_summary: C++/CMake: core/relinker (527 files: RelinkerPipeline, GuestModuleBuilder, LinuxElfPatcher/WindowsPePatcher, entry stubs), core/libs/prx (9,467 files: system library reimplementations incl. libSceAgcDriver), core/shader/recompiler (310: RdnaDecoder, IntermediateRepresentation, ControlFlow, Optimization, SpirvBackend, ShaderDiskCache, PipelineSpecialization), core/Decoder, 3rdparty (SPIRV-Tools, FidelityFX-FSR), tools/ (hw-oracle, library-oracle, isa_profiles.py, trace tools), docs/dev (1,897 files incl. ARCHITECTURE.md). Release assets include prebuilt relinker binaries.

components.cpu_recompiler: Relinker with optional AMD-only -> Intel instruction lowering (--to-intel) - relevant pattern for Zen 2-only instructions on non-AMD hosts.
components.gpu_shader_translation: RDNA2 (and gfx1013) -> IR -> SPIR-V recompiler (core/shader/recompiler/SpirvBackend), validated with SPIRV-Tools; already used by XCL (ported) and cross-checked by TuxBox (BVH emitter). Most mature RDNA2 -> SPIR-V code found.
components.graphics_api: AGC/GNM-equivalent PS5 driver libs -> Vulkan (libSceAgcDriver in core/libs/prx).
components.tooling/tests: Hardware oracle, library oracle, trace diff tools, execution tests (e.g. ScalarSwappcFetch vertex-fetch test).

maturity_evidence: Largest codebase audited (318 MB repo, 50,644 commits, 1,409 contributors since 2026-08-03), versioned releases (v0.1.5), per-game bring-up discussions; README states shader recompiler produces validated SPIR-V. Game compatibility not checked here.

description: Mesa 3D graphics library (GitLab, freedesktop.org)
approach: Open-source Vulkan/OpenGL driver stack; RADV is the AMD Vulkan driver (src/amd/vulkan) and ACO its shader compiler back end (src/amd/compiler, NIR -> AMD ISA). Reference project and runtime target for VIE on Linux.

RADV facts read from src/amd/vulkan/radv_physical_device.c: EXT_mesh_shader only when gfx_level >= GFX10_3 with NGG and ACO; use_ngg requires GFX10+; ray query needs hardware BVH intersect or RT emulation (drirc emulate_rt / experimental flag); minSubgroupSize = 64 before GFX10 (wave64 only), 32 on GFX10+; maxSubgroupSize 64. docs/features.txt: Vulkan 1.4 'radv/gfx8+'; VK_KHR_ray_query 'radv/gfx10.3+'.

components.gpu_shader_translation: ACO compiles in the opposite direction (NIR -> RDNA ISA); useful as an authoritative description of RDNA instruction semantics, encodings (aco_opcodes.py) and hazards, not as a translator.
components.graphics_api: RADV is the Vulkan runtime VIE would run on (Linux, AMD).
